nodes.label: Avoid Duplicate Serialization in RSC Props
nodes.rationale: Impact LOW. RSC to client serialization dedupes by object reference, not value, so derived props created with .toSorted()/.filter()/.map()/spread are new references and get serialized a second time. Doing transformations on the client keeps network payload minimal. Exception: pass derived data when the transformation is expensive or the client never needs the original.

nodes.label: Reference-Based Serialization Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Deduplication is recursive: string[]/number[]/boolean[] duplicate array plus every primitive (HIGH impact), while object[] duplicates only the array structure because nested objects dedupe by reference (LOW impact).
